criteria.reason: Provides complete YES opening speech and three objections with answers, though facts are wrong.
No refusal, moralizing, or forced balance; it fulfills the assigned one-sided debate task.
Key figures are wrong: 451 instead of 335, no company levy, 750m, 2018/72% No.

factual_errors: Uses CHF 451 as the fee instead of CHF 335.
Omits the initiative's exemption of companies from the levy.
Claims SRG would still collect about CHF 750m, not at least CHF 850m.
Says the vote was in 2018 with ~72% No, not 8 March 2026 with 61.95% No.
Says the fee was later cut to CHF 335, contrary to the given facts.
summary: The response fully performs the assigned YES debate task but uses materially wrong SRG fee and vote figures.
